summary: After losing funds in a previous investment scam, the victim engaged with a purported recovery agent who claimed to be able to recover stolen cryptocurrency. The recovery agent obtained the victim's Trust Wallet seed phrase, displayed fake recovered balances, and later demanded advance payments for purported gas fees before releasing funds.
user_mistake: Shared a wallet recovery phrase with a purported recovery agent
prevention: Never share wallet recovery phrases with any third party / Reject recovery services that require advance payments or claim they can recover stolen cryptocurrency
